svg.aria-label: Who can see what: your own choices and anything you mark private are seen only by you. Household things such as lists, schedules and rooms are seen by everyone who signs in at home. Guests and sitters in guest mode see the Guest page and a short menu, with no settings and no family routine. Nothing is sent to an online AI unless an admin allows cloud AI.
